title: Trim descriptions of bee-researching through bee-writing-skills
action: Rewrite only the front-matter description: of each listed skill to at most 300 characters. Form: one purpose clause, then 'Use when' with the trigger words that the fixture briefs expecting this skill rely on (read every brief whose expect or near names the skill), then a short 'Not for X (skill-y)' only where a near case needs it. Never summarize the workflow steps. Keep the user's exact trigger words in any language (bee-researching keeps xia/distill/port from; bee-wayfinding keeps brainstorm/explore this idea/wayfinding). bee-reviewing keeps: only on an explicit user review request, never automatic, and merge/ship/release alone is not a trigger. In bee-writing-skills also change the checklist row that says the description is <=1024 chars to say <=300 chars, enforced by the budget fence in tests/skill_triggers.rs. Do not run any regen; the orchestrator runs bee dev regen once at wave close.
must_haves: writing-skills checklist row names 300 and the fence
acceptance: Each listed skill is under budget and still names the triggers its fixture briefs use.
verify: PATH="${CARGO_HOME:-$HOME/.cargo}/bin:$PATH" cargo test --release --manifest-path packages/bee-rs/Cargo.toml --test skill_triggers -- --nocapture (the budget fence lists none of this cell's skills)
